messages:
maria: Kicking off the "flashswitch" canary run. Plan: enable runtime.ff=flashswitch on the canary pool -> route short sequences (<256) to FlashAttention v3, long sequences to FlashAttention v2, KV cache in paged mode for canary. Need quick signoff and telemetry checklist. :eyes:
ben: quick q — what batching heuristics do we use for mixed-seq traffic? autobatcher currently groups by target model + seq bucket, but we saw latency tail with mixed short+long in previous canaries.
anya: Right. For this canary we set autobatch thresholds: merge if estimated latency delta < 8ms and seq bucket within +/-32. Also enable max_batch_size=48 on canary nodes to limit tail.
kai: Added a small probe to TTL-based KV eviction on canary (paged-mode). If we see cache churn >15%/min we stop the run.
maria: Telemetry checklist (short):
- p50/p95/p99 token latency per kernel (fa_v2/fa_v3)
- QPS and effective batch size distribution
- KV miss rate + regen latency
- Model outputs similarity score on eval promptset (smoke)
- Error rate (5xx, OOMs) and any kernel fallbacks
- infra metrics: GPU SM util, PCIe stall, memcpy times
ben: Can we include the short smoke eval with 100 prompts? I pushed a set to /ci/evals/flashswitch_smoke. Perf-bot can post results.
deploy-bot: To toggle canary: ```sh
curl -X POST https://platform.internal/api/ff/toggle -d '{"flag":"runtime.flashswitch","env":"canary","value":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```
deploy-bot: Canary pool: rg-canary-3, traffic initially 5% -> hold for 30m -> if metrics ok ramp to 25% (1h) -> 100% after 6h and postmortem. Rollback: toggle false, mark pool drain, disable paged-KV and revert cache metadata.
anya: Small note: Flashv3 shows ~6% improvement on short-seq throughput but increases per-request kernel selection overhead by ~1.2ms due to extra route checks. We should add an inlined selector to avoid syscalls.
kai: Profiling snapshot from canary pre-run (micros):
- selector: 1200us
- kernel_launch: 180us
- kv_lookup (paged): 450us
- memcpy_h2d: 600us
- token_compute: 850us

Expect selector to drop to ~300us after inlining.
maria: Also watch batch skew: if avg batch size falls < 8 for GPU nodes, enable batch-padding=auto to avoid small-batch overhead.
ben: Safety nets: enable kernel fallback policy = conservative (allow v3 only if seq <=512 and no quant mismatch), OOM detector -> immediate rollback.
anya: I'm going to run the smoke eval now and post results in 15.
perf-bot: smoke_eval: flashswitch_smoke | baseline-sim=0.987 | avg_sim=0.984 | max_delta=0.02 | issues=0
maria: Nice. No obvious regressions on output quality. Starting canary toggle (5%). @ben @anya please monitor p99.
ben: p95 up 4ms on canary nodes so far, p99 unchanged. batch size distribution looks fine. :thumbsup:
kai: KV miss rate at 1.1% (ok). regen latency mean 12ms, 99th 68ms (under 100ms threshold).
anya: Observed one kernel fallback event (v3->v2) due to quant mismatch on a single model variant, flagged and auto-healed. Investigating root cause — likely model artifact.
maria: Decision: continue ramp to 25% in 30m if no new regressions. Action items:
- ben: add inlined selector PR to reduce routing overhead (small patch, low risk).
- kai: watch KV churn alarm and set temporary throttle if >15%/min.
- anya: add a short-run eval at 25% checkpoint and post results.
- perf-bot: compile daily perf snapshot for canary nodes and compare to baseline.
ben: Will open PR now. ETA ~2h.
anya: noted. I'll be on watch for 3h. If anything spikes, call rollback.
maria: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after 25% checkpoint. :rocket:
